Our Five Over Stripe wallpaper is a classic print that balances crisp lines with inviting texture for a lived in feel. The expert craftsmen at our Dorset factory use a traditional dragging technique to apply stripes of our water based paint, giving each paper a subtle variance.

Full roll width is 53cm/21", roll length is 10m, stripe width is 5.6cm/2 1/4".

The image above and the colours listed are only a guide. To know for sure if this is the perfect paper for your project, please order a sample.

We recommend ordering all the rolls you need in one go because using traditional techniques and real paint, like we do, means pattern and colour can vary very slightly between batches.

Ground Colour:
Pointing 2003
Print Colour:
Joa's White 226

Farrow & Ball Wallpaper

Created using techniques passed down through generations, there’s a legacy of craft in every roll. 

Expertly handcrafted

Over the decades we’ve perfected our distinctive handcrafted wallpapers, preserving generations‑old techniques that take a person months to master.

Our wallpapers are brought to life using traditional paint-on-paper and ink-on-paper techniques, thoughtfully chosen to best realise the character of each design.

From the skill of pattern creation through to the exacting visual checks in production, every stage is human‑led, shaped by patience and precision.

Inspired by colour

For over 80 years, we’ve been creating colour that bring depth, character and atmosphere to every style of home. Our wallpaper collections embody the same philosophy, pairing distinctive palettes with hand-drawn patterns.
 
Each of our wallpapers is crafted on paper that best supports the design, ensuring a smooth application and an exceptional finish.  

Our paint-on-paper designs offer a beautifully tactile surface, the canvas for patterns created with our own distinctive paints. Our ink-on-paper designs are every bit as textural, with the added benefit of a simple, clean hanging experience. 

Sustainably sourced paper

Being conscious of the world around us has always been part of our story. The same care that goes into developing our paint colours, finishes and wallpaper patterns shapes how we choose raw materials and guides our production processes. 

For our wallpaper, that begins with the paper itself. Ours is plastic free, FSC certified and sourced from responsibly managed forests, with thought for local environments and long-term sustainability.
